muc.title: Forty comments
muc.text: You've graded forty essays, and each needs its own comment. That's when AI helps the most.

muc.title: Give AI your rubric
muc.text: Give AI your grading rubric and the grade you gave, and ask it to write a comment with one strength, one thing to fix, and one specific suggestion.

muc.title: Grades are still yours
muc.text: The teacher still decides the grade. AI only helps make the comment clear and warm, without repeating the same template.

muc.title: Remove students' names
muc.text: Before pasting work into AI, remove students' full names and personal details, and use an ID number instead.

muc.title: Five graded essays
muc.text: Pick five graded essays, remove the names, ask AI for comments in the three-part format, then rewrite them in your own voice.
